subject: Science
text: What is the chemical formula of bleaching powder?
explanation: Bleaching powder is chemically calcium oxychloride, represented by the formula \text{CaOCl}_2, produced by action of chlorine on dry slaked lime.

subject: Science
text: Which enzyme present in gastric juice is responsible for the digestion of proteins?
explanation: Pepsin is the protein-digesting enzyme secreted in an inactive form (pepsinogen) by the gastric glands of the stomach.

subject: Science
text: The S.I. unit of electric charge is:
explanation: The S.I. unit of electric charge is the coulomb (C), which is equivalent to the charge of approximately 6 \times 10^{18} electrons.

subject: Science
text: Which gas is evolved when zinc metal reacts with sodium hydroxide solution?
explanation: Zinc reacts with sodium hydroxide to form sodium zincate (\text{Na}_2\text{ZnO}_2) and hydrogen gas (\text{H}_2).

subject: Science
text: The image formed by a plane mirror is always:
explanation: A plane mirror forms an image that is virtual, erect, laterally inverted, and of the same size as the object.

subject: Science
text: Since green plants synthesize their own food, they are called:
explanation: Green plants are autotrophs because they use light energy to synthesize organic molecules from inorganic materials through photosynthesis.

subject: Science
text: An element 'X' reacts with oxygen to form a compound with a high melting point. This compound is also soluble in water. The element 'X' is likely to be:
explanation: Calcium reacts with oxygen to form calcium oxide (\text{CaO}), which has a high melting point and dissolves in water to form calcium hydroxide.

subject: Science
text: The refractive index of medium glass is 1.5. Calculate the speed of light in glass.
explanation: Refractive index n = c/v, where c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}. Thus, v = c/n = (3 \times 10^8)/1.5 = 2 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}.

subject: Science
text: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for promoting cell division?
explanation: Cytokinins are plant hormones that promote cell division (cytokinesis) and are present in greater concentrations in areas of rapid cell division.

subject: Science
text: The resistivity of a metallic conductor depends on which of the following factors?
explanation: Resistivity is an intrinsic property of a material; it depends on the nature of the material and the temperature, not on dimensions like length or area.

options.text: Nature of the material and temperature
Area of cross-section of the conductor

subject: Science
text: What is the main component of biogas and compressed natural gas (CNG)?
explanation: Methane (\text{CH}_4) makes up to 75% of biogas and is the primary constituent of CNG, making it an excellent fuel.

subject: Science
text: A solution turns blue litmus paper red. Its pH is likely to be:
explanation: Acidic solutions turn blue litmus paper red and have a pH value less than 7.

subject: Science
text: Which of the following organisms reproduces asexually through regeneration?
explanation: Simple organisms like Planaria and Hydra can be cut into pieces, and each piece grows into a complete organism through regeneration.

subject: Science
text: Why is tungsten metal selected almost exclusively for making filaments of electric incandescent lamps?
explanation: Tungsten has a very high melting point (3380°C) and does not oxidize (burn) easily at high temperatures, allowing it to become white-hot without melting.

options.text: It has a very high melting point and does not oxidize easily at high temperatures.
It has very low electrical resistivity, minimizing power consumption.
It is highly ductile and can be drawn into very thin wires easily.
It reacts with nitrogen and argon gases to emit brighter light.

subject: Science
text: If a normal human eye cannot see objects clearly placed closer than 25 cm, it is because:
explanation: The ciliary muscles cannot contract beyond a limit to increase the curvature and power of the eye lens further. Hence, the focal length cannot be decreased below a certain limit.

options.text: The ciliary muscles cannot contract further to decrease the focal length of the eye lens.
The retina moves slightly forward, changing the image distance.
Light rays from nearby objects are absorbed by the cornea.
The iris cannot constrict further to regulate light entry.

subject: Science
text: What is the thermite reaction, and what is its primary industrial application?
explanation: The thermite reaction is a highly exothermic displacement reaction between iron(III) oxide and aluminium powder: \text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3(s) + 2\text{Al}(s) \rightarrow 2\text{Fe}(l) + \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3(s). The molten iron is used to join railway tracks.

options.text: Reaction of iron oxide with aluminium; used to join railway tracks.
Reaction of zinc oxide with carbon; used to extract zinc metal.
Reaction of copper oxide with hydrogen; used to purify copper.
Electrolysis of alumina; used to obtain pure aluminium metal.

subject: Science
text: How many structural isomers are possible for Butane (\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10})?
explanation: Butane has two structural isomers: n-butane (straight chain) and isobutane (2-methylpropane, branched chain).

subject: Science
text: What is the primary role of the secretions of seminal vesicles and prostate gland in the male reproductive system?
explanation: Their secretions provide nutrition to sperms and make transport easier by providing a liquid medium, which also reduces acidity in the urethra.

options.text: Providing nutrients and a fluid medium for sperm transport and survival.
Directly producing sperm cells by cell division.
Secreting testosterone to stimulate sperm production.

subject: Science
text: When a ray of light passes from an optically denser medium to an optically rarer medium, it:
explanation: Light speeds up in a rarer medium, which causes it to bend away from the normal line.

options.text: speeds up and bends away from the normal
slows down and bends towards the normal
speeds up and bends towards the normal
slows down and bends away from the normal

subject: Science
text: Why are electrical appliances connected in parallel instead of series in domestic circuits?
explanation: Parallel circuits ensure each appliance receives the same voltage (220 V), can be operated independently with its own switch, and if one appliance fails, others continue to work.

options.text: To ensure each appliance gets full voltage, independent control, and safety from single points of failure.
To increase the total resistance of the circuit and minimize current flow.
To ensure that all appliances draw the exact same current.
To reduce the cost of copper wiring in domestic connections.

subject: Science
text: Two solutions A and B have pH values of 6.0 and 8.0 respectively. Which solution has a higher hydrogen ion concentration, and by how much?
explanation: pH = -\log[\text{H}^+]. A decrease in pH by 1 unit corresponds to a 10-fold increase in [\text{H}^+]. Thus, A (pH 6) has 100 times higher [\text{H}^+] than B (pH 8).

options.text: Solution A has 100 times higher concentration of hydrogen ions.
Solution B has 100 times higher concentration of hydrogen ions.
Solution A has 2 times higher concentration of hydrogen ions.
Solution A has 10 times higher concentration of hydrogen ions.

subject: Science
text: What is the biological significance of double circulation in the human cardiovascular system?
explanation: Double circulation completely separates oxygenated and deoxygenated blood, which is essential to provide highly efficient oxygen delivery to maintain constant body temperature in warm-blooded animals.

options.text: It separates oxygenated and deoxygenated blood, providing efficient oxygen delivery for thermoregulation.
It doubles the blood pressure to ensure faster transport of hormones.
It allows carbon dioxide to be absorbed directly by body tissues without reaching lungs.
It prevents blood from flowing back into the ventricles during cardiac cycles.

subject: Science
text: An electric oven rated at 2.0 kW is operated in a domestic circuit of 220 V that has a current rating of 5 A. What will happen when the oven is switched on?
explanation: Current drawn I = P/V = 2000 W / 220 V \approx 9.09 A. Since the current drawn (9.09 A) exceeds the circuit rating (5 A), the fuse will melt and break the circuit.

options.text: The circuit fuse will melt and break the circuit due to overloading.
The oven will run at half its maximum power rating.
The voltage of the domestic circuit will drop to 110 V.
The oven will function normally without any interruption.

subject: Science
text: Which of the following is correct regarding homologous organs?
explanation: Homologous organs (e.g., limbs of human, bird, lizard) share a common basic structure and evolutionary origin, but have adapted to perform different functions.

options.text: They have similar basic design and origin, but perform different functions.
They have different basic design and origin, but perform similar functions.
They are structures that have lost all their functions during evolution.
They are structures found only in invertebrate animals.

subject: Science
text: An unsaturated hydrocarbon 'A' has the molecular formula \text{C}_2\text{H}_4. When heated with hydrogen in the presence of nickel catalyst, it forms a saturated compound 'B'. Identify A and B.
explanation: Ethene (\text{C}_2\text{H}_4) undergoes an addition reaction (hydrogenation) in the presence of a Ni catalyst to form Ethane (\text{C}_2\text{H}_6).
